product: Stonewake (app.stonewake.ai + api.stonewake.ai): B2B SaaS dashboard for export/project/real-estate finance desks. Finalist 4 workspace only (D15).
generatedBy: Recon agent from docs/BASELINE.md, docs/product/JUDGES_FOCUS.md, AT_A_GLANCE.md, DEMO_VIDEO.md, notes-A/B/C.md. No crawler site map yet. Flows already covered by the 20 original tests are dropped (see notes).
ordering: Risk = impact x likelihood. Judges' six flows (F1 Deal Book, F2 Screenings, F3 Network/Institutions, F4 Countries, F5 Monitoring/Portfolio, F6 API/MCP) first, then auth checklist, then universal layers.

items.title: Deal Book: filter by sector narrows the list and every visible deal matches the filter
items.notes: impact high x likelihood high. ui 7 covers free-text search only. Pin the team first (Deal Book changes with the team).

items.title: Deal Book: open a deal shows brief, key facts and at least one source link (view at source)
items.notes: impact high x likelihood medium. ui 7 only checks the Briefing heading. Oracle: every fact cites a source.

items.title: Deal Book: Export downloads an .xlsx and deal page Download report downloads a .pdf
items.notes: impact high x likelihood medium. waitForEvent('download') + suggestedFilename extension; no file content diff.

items.title: Deal Book: sort order (highest score / newest / A-Z) orders the list as chosen
items.notes: impact medium x likelihood medium. Compare with API sort+direction where possible.

items.title: Screenings: screening of a company shows a verdict and every finding cites a source
items.notes: impact high x likelihood high. Not covered (ui 6 only reaches the page). Prefer opening an existing screening; New screening creates data: RUN_ID name, own workspace only.

items.title: Screenings: a person screening never shows a rating
items.notes: impact high (compliance rule stated in AT_A_GLANCE) x likelihood medium. Strong bug oracle.

items.title: Screenings: screening downloads as a PDF report
items.notes: impact medium x likelihood medium.

items.title: Network: company lookup shows owners, officers and ownership chain, each linked to a source
items.notes: impact high x likelihood high. Not covered. Less data alone is not a bug (restricted datasets).

items.title: Institutions: Kind and Country filters narrow the registry
items.notes: impact medium x likelihood medium. ui 9 covers search + open only, not the filters.

items.title: Countries: country profile shows a risk score and cited indicators (TI, World Bank, sanctions, FATF)
items.notes: impact high x likelihood medium. ui 8 checks only headings on DEU.

items.title: Countries: risk tiles (High/Elevated/Moderate/Unscored) counts match the table and API

items.title: Countries: Export downloads an .xlsx
items.notes: impact medium x likelihood low.

items.notes: impact high x likelihood high. Mutation in a shared account: one company reserved per test, cleanup in fixture teardown, never run in parallel with itself. Ask judges if no reset exists.

items.title: Monitoring: pause, resume and change frequency of a followed item
items.notes: impact medium x likelihood medium. Restore original state in teardown.

items.notes: impact high x likelihood medium. ui 10 checks tile visibility only, not values.

items.notes: impact high x likelihood high. Measured at recon: /v1/health 404, /health 200. Decide automation fault vs product change with judges; fixes api 1.

items.notes: impact high x likelihood medium. Not covered by api 1-10.
